name: daniel-km/omeka-s-module-single-sign-on
description: Module for Omeka S: Authenticate automatically on Omeka S via single sign-on (SSO) through SAML or Shibboleth and manage multiple identity providers automatically.
_note (xmlseclibs): php-saml 4.3.2 caps xmlseclibs to ^3.1.5, but that constraint was published in May 2026, three months before xmlseclibs 4.0.0 (August 2026), so it is stale rather than a statement of incompatibility. The source of php-saml 4.3.2 is identical to 4.3.1, whose constraint (>=3.1.4) did allow 4.0.0. Version 4.0.0 hardens the SAML attack surface (DOCTYPE and entity-reference signature bypass, RSA-1.5 key transport denied, algorithm and key binding, SSRF on cert fetch), so it is aliased in until php-saml widens the constraint upstream.
_note (php-saml version): The exact version is required by the patch below: a context patch silently breaks composer install on an untested release.
